translations.translatedText: # Friday 29.5.2020 (radio)

The Ministry of Social Affairs and Health has made a study on face masks. Schools are ending, but graduation parties will not be held. Parliament has approved new guidelines for restaurants. The weather this weekend is beautiful.
## Face masks
![a man wears a protective mask](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11335665)
Open image viewer
A face mask covers the mouth and nose. Photo: Marja Väänänen / Yle
The Ministry of Social Affairs and Health has made a study on face masks because of the coronavirus. People can cover their mouth and nose with a face mask.
The study says that a face mask does not have a great significance. A face mask does not prevent viruses from spreading.
The study goes to the Finnish government. The government will deal with the matter next week. Then the government will decide whether it recommends using a face mask because of the corona.
## Schools
![A matriculation student holds their cap in their hand, looking at it.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10811111)
Open image viewer
New matriculation students and those who have graduated from vocational training will have to wait for bigger celebrations until the autumn. Photo: Henrietta Hassinen / Yle
Schools end this weekend.
However, schools will not hold graduation parties now because of the corona. The celebrations will be moved to the autumn.
Now celebrations are held at most over a remote connection, and pupils get their certificates by post.
About 25,000 new matriculation students have graduated this spring. About 47,000 students have graduated from vocational training.
On the Yle website, the vocational graduates list was published on Friday. From there you can see who has graduated from vocational training.
The matriculation list was published earlier in May. From there you can see the names of the new matriculation students.
The vocational graduates list (Amiskone) and the matriculation list (ylioppilaskone) can be found at yle.fi.
## Restaurants
![Closed restaurant area in Tapiola, Espoo.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3506,h_1972,x_0,y_104/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-6652295e987324963c6/1587634778)
Open image viewer
Restaurants have been closed this spring because of the corona. Photo: Henrietta Hassinen / Yle
Parliament has approved the new restrictions for restaurants. The government proposed the restrictions last week.
Restrictions are needed so that the coronavirus does not spread in restaurants. Restaurants may open their doors to customers on Monday after the corona break.
The new restrictions say that restaurants may be open until 23:00. However, the sale of alcohol must stop already at 22:00.
Restaurants may let in half as many customers as before. If a restaurant could before take in 100 customers at once, now there may only be 50 customers.
## Corona situation

![A researcher wearing rubber gloves holds a vaccine being developed against Covid-19.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3779,h_2126,x_0,y_6/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-6797265ec8414e0318c/1594039034)
Open image viewer
Researchers are trying to find a vaccine against corona. Photo: Rungroj Yongrit / EPA
In Finland, one new corona death was reported on Friday. The coronavirus has now killed 314 people in Finland in total.
So far, almost 6,800 Finns have caught the coronavirus infection. On Friday it was reported that there are 33 new infections.
## Weather

![Seascape in Espoo, a summer cottage on the opposite shore.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3088,h_1737,x_0,y_323/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-6774175ebfdf644362f/1589633438)
Open image viewer
It is good weather for outdoor activities at the weekend. Photo: Henrietta Hassinen / Yle
The weather this weekend is beautiful.
On Saturday it is dry, that is, it does not rain. The temperature is between 15 and 20 degrees in most of the country.
On Sunday even warmer air will come from the west. The temperature is about 20 degrees in almost the whole country.
The weather will also be warm early next week.
